title: Concept: SHA-1 use via CC_SHA1 (objc) — review required
description: In objc, CC_SHA1 computes SHA-1. Public collision demonstrations ended SHA-1's suitability for signatures and integrity, though content addressing and legacy interop remain legitimate. The objc-specific remedy is CC_SHA256.
applicability: objc codebases hashing data through CC_SHA1; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Forged signatures and integrity values where SHA-1 guards trust; LOW default severity, raised when the digest is security-relevant.
